invariants.rationale: The method always returns a Stream; Collectors.groupingBy and Stream operations may return empty but not null streams.
Parallelism value is used for parallel streams; expected to be positive in this context.
The input stream is likely non-null as method does not handle/predicate on null.
flatMapToPairFunc is invoked via a wrapper and is required to process input.
reduceFunc is passed into throwingReduceWrapper, so must be non-null for reduce operation.
